setting: The Battle of Zhovti Vody, late April to mid-May 1648, in the Wild Fields between the Dnipro and the Inhulets: the small marshy Zhovti Vody stream with reedy banks, rolling spring feather-grass steppe in fresh green, and the final ambush at the Kniazhi Bairaky ravines, where a dirt road runs down between two wooded ravines (balky) with small groves of oak, hornbeam and wild pear. Cossacks dig a waist-deep trench across the road hidden under turf, with earth banks and branch-camouflaged wagons on the left and right forming a crescent. The Polish punitive force moves in a rectangular wagon tabor with heavy cavalry front and rear, harried by Crimean Tatar horsemen.

characters.ivan_hladkyi: Ivan Hladkyi, 40-year-old Zaporozhian Cossack of the Novobasan sotnia, lean wiry build, sun-darkened weathered face with deep crow's feet, grey-blue eyes, shaved head with a long dark-brown forelock tucked behind his left ear, long drooping dark-brown mustache touched with grey, clean-shaven chin, small white scar across the bridge of his nose, off-white linen shirt, short dark-green wool zhupan, dark-blue sharovary, wide red sash, worn yellow leather boots, cow-horn powder horn on a cord, leather bandolier of wooden charges, shablia in a black scabbard, long walnut-stocked flintlock samopal with an engraved Kyiv-made lock
characters.ivan_young: young Ivan Hladkyi, 18 years old, lean boyish face with the same grey-blue eyes and straight nose, first thin dark-brown mustache, shaved head with a short dark-brown forelock, coarse undyed linen shirt, brown wool sharovary, plain rope-and-cloth sash, soft brown boots, an old plain matchlock samopal
characters.ivan_father: Ivan's father, 45-year-old Cossack frontiersman, broad shoulders, deeply lined leathery face, grey-blue eyes, long grey forelock, thick grey drooping mustache, sheepskin vest over a sweat-stained linen shirt, faded red sharovary, leather belt with powder horn and knife, long matchlock samopal
characters.kurinnyi: the kurinnyi otaman of Ivan's kurin, 55 years old, stocky and barrel-chested, ruddy wind-burnt face, bushy white drooping mustache, shaved head with a white forelock wound behind the ear, deep old scar down the left cheek, faded crimson zhupan, black sash with a pistol, black lambswool kalpak, shablia at his hip, a leather nahaika whip on the wrist
characters.nechai: Colonel Danylo Nechai, 36 years old, slim athletic build, lean high-cheekboned face, sharp dark eyes, black forelock, black drooping mustache, dark-blue zhupan with silver frogging, crimson sash, red morocco boots, sable kalpak with a small heron feather, silver pernach mace tucked in the sash, shablia with a silver hilt
characters.khmelnytskyi: Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytskyi, 52 years old, heavy-set and broad-shouldered, broad high-cheekboned face, heavy dark mustache streaked with grey, small tuft of beard under the lower lip, short-cropped greying hair, sable-trimmed kalpak with a white heron-feather plume in a jewelled clasp, crimson fur-lined kuntush over a gold-brocade zhupan, golden sash, yellow boots, gilded bulava
characters.stefan_potocki: Stefan Potocki, 24-year-old Polish magnate and commander, slim, pale smooth aristocratic face, thin dark mustache, no beard, hair shaved high at the sides and back in Polish noble style with a dark crop on top, crimson silk zupan, sapphire-blue fur-lined delia with gold buttons, jewelled karabela sabre, yellow boots
characters.polish_gunner: the Polish gunner, 35 years old, stocky, ruddy stubbled face, short brown hair under a grey felt cap, buff leather jerkin over a grey wool doublet, soot-blackened hands, smouldering linstock
characters.mad_hussar: the dazed Polish hussar nobleman, about 30, wild staring pale-blue eyes, blond mustache, helmet lost, sweat-matted fair hair, face smeared with soot and dust, dented steel breastplate over a crimson zupan
characters.polish_hussars: Polish heavy hussar cavalry of 1648 without wings: lobster-tailed szyszak helmets, polished steel breastplates and arm guards over crimson zupans, a few leopard pelts over shoulders, very long lances with red-and-white pennons, sabres, big dark warhorses
characters.jalai: Jalai, 45-year-old Crimean Tatar warrior, wiry, deeply tanned leathery face, narrow dark eyes in deep creases, thin black mustache and sparse greying chin beard, tall black sheepskin cap, quilted dark-red kaftan with a leather belt, composite bow in a decorated leather saadak and quiver at the hip, curved sabre, small shaggy dun steppe horse
characters.tatar_murza: the Tatar commander, about 50, heavy-set, black beard shot with grey, hawk nose, richly embroidered green silk kaftan stained with dust and dark spatters, fur-trimmed cap with a plume, gilded sabre, grey Arabian horse with a decorated bridle
characters.sava: Sava of the Bykiv sotnia, 30-year-old Cossack, tall and rawboned, freckled sunburnt face, red-blond forelock, ginger drooping mustache, rough white linen shirt with rolled sleeves, red sharovary, leather belt, carries a rohach boar spear
characters.basan_sotnyk: the Basan sotnyk, 48 years old, broad and solid, weathered face, black-and-grey drooping mustache, grey forelock, dark-red zhupan, wolf-fur kalpak, leather bandolier, shablia

palette: Passages: monochrome sepia/graphite on ivory paper. Cover: original full-color photographic palette.
notes: Ozhyha = Cossack organ gun: a row of up to 18 short iron barrels bound side by side on a heavy oak frame on a two-wheeled cart, with a common powder trough over the touch-holes. Samopal = long flintlock musket; each shooter has three or four loaded samopals. Polish army: hussars WITHOUT wings, haiduk infantry in blue coats, servants in plain grey and brown, wagon tabor of heavy carts. Tatars: quilted kaftans, sheepskin caps, composite bows, lassos, small steppe horses. Signal: a single whistling (notched) bullet fired by Nechai, shown only as one puff of smoke. Ivan's injuries are branch-specific: in r.0.0 his right hand gets burned (wrapped in a scorched rag) and later a grazing wound to the scalp (linen bandage round the head). Violence is always implied: smoke, flashes, distant falling figures; no wounds or severed limbs shown even where the text describes them. Potocki in the r.1 branch is captured wearing only a coarse servant's linen shirt, face bruised.
cover_palette: spring steppe greens and ochre road dust, wet brown earth of fresh trenches, dense white-grey powder smoke, dark oak shade; accents of Cossack crimson, dark blue and green wool, Polish crimson and sapphire silks, glints of steel; warm gold sunrise and sunset, cold blue moonlight for the night march
illustration_notes: Westerveld-inspired original drawings, static ink reveal, no ambient distortion. References establish medium and protagonist identity only. Preserve branch-specific costume, injuries and survivors. Full-color ultra-realistic photographic cover.
